verdict.rationale: The public Models page publishes a per-token price with no sales contact: $42 per billion or $0.042 per million input tokens, with output tokens free. The quickstart also documents self-serve Playground access. However, the evidence shows only a single price row, so it is not shown that each current model (jev-latest, jev-preview, versioned jev-1.13.0) has its own explicit price. Missing for 10: an explicit per-model price for every current model ID, independent corroboration of the published pricing.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every current model without talking to sales

citations.quote: Charged per input token. Output tokens are free.
Every model on this page is served by the same endpoint, `POST /v1/systemone`.
